# Dawid Olko

> Personal website of Dawid Olko, a Fullstack / AI Developer from Rzeszów, Poland: projects, studies, a photo blog and contact details.

## Pages

- [Home](https://dawidolko.pl/): Who Dawid Olko is, selected projects and contact details.
- [Projects](https://dawidolko.pl/projects): Every project with its dates, stack and links.
- [Blog](https://dawidolko.pl/blog): A personal photo blog about studies, travel and programming.
- [Studies](https://dawidolko.pl/studies): Computer Science at the University of Rzeszów.
- [Hobbies](https://dawidolko.pl/hobbies): Gaming setups, hardware builds and interests outside work.
- [Gallery](https://dawidolko.pl/gallery): Personal photographs.
- [Contact](https://dawidolko.pl/contact): Email and social profiles.
- [FAQ](https://dawidolko.pl/faq): Questions about technologies, working style and interests.
